# Nuzira

> > Nuzira is a specialized camera store offering professional cinema lenses, broadcast equipment, camera support systems, and videography gear from brands like Tokina Cinema, Fujinon, Meike Cinema, Kondor Blue, OZEN, and Blackmagic Design.

Nuzira serves filmmakers, videographers, and broadcast professionals with a curated selection of cinema-grade equipment. The store focuses on professional video production tools including cinema prime and zoom lenses across multiple mounts (EF, PL, L, MFT, X), camera rigs and cages, tripod systems, broadcast cameras, and production accessories.

## Key Topics

- Cinema Lenses
- Tokina Vista Series
- Meike Cinema Primes
- Fujinon Broadcast Lenses
- EF Mount & PL Mount
- Kondor Blue Camera Rigs
- OZEN Tripod Systems
- Camera Support & Cages
- Full-Frame & Micro Four Thirds
- Video Production Equipment
- Broadcast Cameras
- Blackmagic Design
- Imperial Focus Scale
- 6G-SDI & 4K/UHD
- ENG/EFP Production
